svg.title: Nómos — architecture
svg.text: Nómos — reading the law to update EUROMOD parameters
Multilingual retrieval over the legislation of 5 member states · agentic proposals · human validation · evaluation against a golden set
a lead to ingest, never a citation
the only process with the GPU, the model keys and internet access
every version of every article, dated
warm encoder for live UI search
one run per country × parameter × year
retrieve — hybrid search: vectors + full text + cross-references
propose · critique — LLM with structured output (PydanticAI)
scout — act missing? search the web, ingest it, retry
every value quoted character-for-character from the law
everything runtime is a row — nothing is a file
swappable by configuration: Activity 5 compares models
API keys live on the worker, never on a workstation
“why did this run fail?” — open its trace
storage: the phoenix database, same Postgres
Nothing reaches EUROMOD without an explicit Accept;
every decision is kept with its reviewer and date.

g.text: Every value quoted verbatim from the law
UI runs nothing · the worker runs all
Any LLM, scored on the same golden set
